intended_outcome: Cut review rounds that add no assurance and make the human cost measurable, without lowering any control on code, tests or security posture: a declared review budget with a recorded stop menu, advisory record-text findings, verified pack facts and request and answer timestamps.

acceptance_criteria.text: Stop rule: core/05-review.md sections 2 and 5 and templates/task-contract.md define a declared review budget (T2 default two Verifier rounds; T3 two Verifier and two Security) and, when the last budgeted round does not pass, a recorded Change Owner choice of merge with advisories, accept a named residual, split, stop, or one more round (only for a rank-1 finding in code, tests or security posture). A T3 residual may be accepted as named and scoped; this never waives required evidence and never accepts a rank-1 behavior defect with a reproducing case. A contract without a budget keeps the two-round maximum.

Record text cannot block: core/05-review.md section 4 makes a finding whose only subject is narrative, a count or history in an evidence pack or dispositions file advisory, fixed by an append; it still blocks when it overstates a guarantee a consumer relies on, a required artifact, rehearsal or acceptance is missing, a gate-used SHA, digest or hash is wrong, or the record contradicts the code or tests it describes.

Pack facts: verification/pack_facts.py fails when a security_evidence artifact that names a committed file (alone or as its first word) has a wrong artifact_sha256 or when an artifact that looks like a file names no committed file, when a cited hexadecimal string of 7 to 40 characters does not resolve to a git object, or when a cited test_ name is not defined in a tracked Python file; templates/evidence-pack.md says reviewers do not argue these three facts.

Human time: templates/approval-request.md has Requested (UTC), Answered (UTC) and Active minutes (manual); metrics/definitions.md defines the metric as an upper bound with the manual field beside it; verification/human_time.py prints the request count, the upper bound and the manual sum, counting incomplete requests as unknown.

Protected checker unchanged: verification/aidf_check.py is attested by the protected policy repository and is not changed by this change (git diff of the merge base with main against HEAD for that path is empty). The pending-criterion status (pending_outcome, --final, outcome_record_criteria) is deferred to a later cross-repository T3 change.

Tests and replay: each rule has a counterfactual test that fails against the previous text or code; verification/review_rule_replay.py reports, on the hand-labelled findings, how many reports contained only record text; CHANGELOG.md records the change as migration-required for contracts that adopt a budget; spec/adr/review-stop-rule.md records the decision.
Scope: no change to KERNEL.md, the trip-wires, core/02-authority.md, verification/aidf_check.py, or any section of core/05-review.md other than 2, 4 and 5.

Outcome records (core/05-review.md section 6): the review report patterns are verification/review-efficiency-core-verifier-report*.md; the dispositions file is verification/review-efficiency-core-verifier-dispositions.md. This criterion only declares the outcome-record paths. The merger runs verification/review_head_binding_evidence.py compare() from the reviewed head of the last round to the final head and records its output in the dispositions; the evidence pack does not change after the last review.
